# Gilly SMP

> Last updated: 2026-11-01. Gilly SMP is a free, non pay-to-win Minecraft survival SMP with crossplay between Java, Bedrock, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch, and playtime sync (inventory, XP) via linked accounts. It runs a custom survival rework for Minecraft 26.3 that makes progression slow and casual-friendly. Full player documentation: https://craft.gillyb.net/wiki.html

## How to join
- Java: mc.gillyb.net (Minecraft Java 26.3 required)
- Bedrock: mc.gillyb.net, port 19132
- Console (Xbox / PlayStation / Switch): add "GillySMP" as a friend, then join from the Friends tab. The console's online subscription is required by the console maker.
- Java players get the Gilly SMP resource pack (item names and textures) automatically when they join; no manual download is needed. Bedrock cannot load it and shows vanilla textures; everything still works.
- Bedrock names get a "_" prefix (e.g. _Steve) so they never clash with Java names.

## Theme
Fair, friendly survival for players who like to take their time. Strictly non pay-to-win: the store sells only quality-of-life items and cosmetics. Playable from anywhere, even from a plane over the Atlantic.

## Target players
Casual and adult survival players, friend groups, and players on different platforms who want one shared world.

## Gameplay
- Custom survival rework: reworked progression with alloys (Hepatizon, Shakudo, Steel, Electrum, Adamant) smithed onto copper, iron and diamond; about 50 new foods; new structures; reworked villager trades and enchanting; around 100 fish via the Angler's Almanac; 7 new music discs; about 1275 recipes and 880 advancements that guide players.
- No natural regeneration and no hunger; healing comes from food effects.
- Deaths keep the inventory and XP but cost 1 maximum heart (never below 10 hearts on Easy). Crystal Hearts restore hearts, up to 30.
- Creepers, spiders and other non-undead monsters don't spawn in the open; zombies and skeletons still do at night. The surface becomes fully safe after the Ender Dragon is first defeated. No phantoms. True darkness. Explosions drop every block.
- Nether and End are currently closed and open in stages; the Nether opens after the next major update.
- Ranks Bronze, Gold and Diamond raise ender chest size (3 to 6 rows), homes (2 to 6) and order-market slots (5 to 15), plus a name tag.
- Points currency, a player order market (5 to 15 active orders, 14-day expiry), safe player trades with a 20-second cooldown, an RTP cannon (no /rtp), ranged chat (100 blocks, ! to shout), an AFK zone instead of a disconnect, proximity voice chat (Java, push-to-talk on Caps Lock), and a /menu for Bedrock players.
- AFK: marked after 5 minutes idle, disconnected after 10 more; if the main server restarts while idle, players land in the AFK zone and return with /server smp.

## Server facts
- Hosted in France, around 100 ms from the US
- Easy difficulty, up to 20 players, no whitelist, online mode (legitimate accounts only)
- PvP allowed with fair play; griefing and stealing forbidden (warning, then temporary ban); no land claiming
- World resets every season; a copy is available on request via Discord one week after the season ends
- Staff contact and ban appeals: Discord ticket (fastest) or gilly-smp@outlook.com
